title: Coval, which develops simulation and evaluation tech for testing, launching, and monitoring AI voice and chat agents, raised a $28M Series A led by Norwest (Duncan Riley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Duncan Riley / SiliconANGLE: Coval, which develops simulation and evaluation tech for testing, launching, and monitoring AI voice and chat agents, raised a $28M Series A led by Norwest — Voice artificial intelligence testing startup Coval Inc. revealed today that it has raised $28 million in new funding to expand …
